headline: TikTok has made its advertising tools available as a built-in connector in AI assistants including Claude and Perplexity, though billing tools are left out of the Claude version.
score_reason: Meaningful for advertisers, but the main announcement dates from 5 Oct and the growth figure is TikTok's own with no baseline.
importance_line: Advertisers can link TikTok ad accounts to AI assistants in a few clicks, while payment tools still need manual setup, and TikTok's 200% growth claim comes with no starting number.
summary: The Keyword reports, citing a TikTok Newsroom post from Advertising Week New York on 5 Oct 2026, that TikTok's ads MCP server (a standard connector that lets AI assistants use another company's tools) is now listed as a ready-made connector in eight platforms, including Claude and Perplexity. The version in Claude's directory leaves out 26 of about 400 tools, mostly billing and payment functions, and TikTok's claim of more than 200% growth in advertisers using it comes with no starting figure.
notes: The Keyword reports TikTok's announcement; growth figure is TikTok's internal claim. The original is TikTok Newsroom, not read.
